name: Thomil
description: Planeswalker and Worzel's rival, who uses red and black magic with dragons, sea serpents, zombies and demons.

description_citations.text: "Worzel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Summoned to duel by rival planeswalkers, Sauruven kills his new friend Eumenes, sings the lament, and later kills the Stone Giant.
timeline.quote: the knight kills the minotaur, sings the lament for his friend, and later goes and kills the Stone Giant.

citation.text: "Tapestries", section "The Lament , by S. M. Stirling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Worzel summons Segovian angels against Thomil's gnats in one of the Multiverse's least destructive battles.
timeline.quote: When Worzel summoned Segovian angels to fight Thomil's Gargantikari gnats, the ensuing battle numbered among the Multiverse's least destructive.

citation.text: Segovian Angel (Modern Horizons, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After losing to Thomil's red magic and dragons, Worzel seeks a white-magic wizard, offers the Glasses of Urza, and coerces him by winning a duel, letting him keep the artifact.
timeline.quote: She coerced this wizard into instructing her by defeating him in a duel

citation.text: "Worzel", section "First duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thomil challenges Worzel again; she stalls with green minions while Thomil surprisingly summons zombies; the outcome is unknown.
timeline.quote: The outcome of the battle is unknown.

citation.text: "Worzel", section "First duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Worzel planeswalks to Ergamon, detects Thomil, and duels him with braided leylines, summoning sprites and bears and casting lightning; Thomil answers with black magic and zombies; she stalls with a blue storm.
timeline.quote: used a red leyline to evoke lightning bolts against Thomil

citation.text: "Worzel", section "Gathering leylines on Ergamon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thomil summons a Lord of the Pit; Worzel finally finds a white leyline and casts Circle of Protection: Black, withstanding the demon.
timeline.quote: Finally, with a white leyline, Worzel cast a Circle of Protection: Black

citation.text: "Worzel", section "Gathering leylines on Ergamon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Lord of the Pit turns on Thomil, who flees the plane; Worzel planeswalks back to Cabralin with Roreca.
timeline.quote: He fled the plane, and his summoned demon vanished after raging around the plane for a time.

citation.text: "Worzel", section "Gathering leylines on Ergamon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
